notes: Assertions are at the prompt-assembly level: fetched news headlines must arrive inside the news-content delimiters as data, the prompt must carry a data-is-not-instructions line, and embedded END markers must be defused. Model-behavior grading (does a live model obey an injection despite the defense) is a separate, non-CI evaluation; the enforcement layer behind the prompt (bounded sentiment classification, no tool access on this path) is covered by its own tests.
provenance: Synthetic red-team fixtures for the news-sentiment prompt-injection defense (RSI-InfoSec #764, AISecOps #767 path 4, follow-up #881). NOT production news items; they exist to exercise the defended prompt assembly deterministically in CI.
runner: tests/news_sentiment_injection_evalset.test.ts — assembles each case through the production buildNewsSentimentPrompt (src/trading/options/flows/newsSentiment.ts, #881) with the case headline as a single news item and asserts the separation invariants per case, plus a negative control (the separation-stripped assembly, byte-equivalent to the pre-#881 bare interpolation, must fail the same invariants).
